event_name: Date 01 October 2022 Time 23:19 2022 SINGAPORE GRAND PRIX 29 September - 02 October 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (Document 30) and heard from the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine
fact: Wearing of jewellery during the competition.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter III of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 44 (Lewis Hamilton), the team representative and have reviewed video and audio evidence. Broadcast footage showed HAM wearing an item of jewellery in the form of a body piercing (nose stud) during the session. HAM admitted this fact but explained that he had been advised by his doctors not to remove it for the time being. In response to a request by the Stewards, the team produced reports from a medical practitioner which confirmed HAM's explanation. The Stewards then consulted the FIA Deputy Medical Delegate, Dr Ian Roberts, who viewed the medical report and concurred with the opinion therein. In light of the extenuating circumstances, we have determined to take no further action.
rules_referenced: Chapter III of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 44 Breach Of Appendix L
to: The Team Manager, Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team
